DLR.reason: DOCKLANDS LIGHT RAILWAY: Saturday 13 and Sunday 14 June, no service between Poplar and Beckton. Replacement bus service DLR2 operates between Canary Wharf and Gallions Reach via Blackwall (for Poplar), East India, Canning Town, Royal Victoria (Victoria Dock Road), Custom House, Prince Regent, Beckton Park, Cyprus and Beckton,

Victoria.reason: Victoria Line: Severe delays due to a track fault at Walthamstow Central. Tickets will be accepted on London Buses, London Overground, Great Northern, Thameslink, Greater Anglia, South Western Railway and Southeastern via any reasonable route.

Waterloo & City.reason: Waterloo & City line: service operates 06:00 until 00:30, Monday to Friday only. There is no service on Saturdays, Sundays and on bank/public holidays.
